notes.note: Delta-only review for Context Map: the device change adds per-agent overlapping-operation accounting, complete-in-one-batch pointer/key admission, full-batch kind preflight, post-release input lease replies and early operator refusal for close. Reviewed against this document purpose and the cited changed inputs (docs/architecture/module-map.md, src-server/services/devices/device-automation.ts, src-server/tools/station-control-device-tools.ts). These changes are limited to the local device-agent path; unrelated Browser, transport, native shell, deployment, account and Project contracts remain unchanged. This is not a renewed whole-document or live-device audit. The Device guide and device-agent-control decision own the updated behavior and unsupported cross-call/timed-hold limits. The final follow-up serializes input batches while allowing concurrent observations and cancels failed held input immediately; a pre-fix service probe delivered three of four expected touch events, and the final fault matrix covers removal of batch sequencing and failure cancellation.
